newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air offers 40 pct discount.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air offers 40 pct discount.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Monday it would offer holiday travelers savings of up to 40 percent off regular excursion fares during the December 19-January 7 holiday period.
Tickets must be purchased by December 20 and are non-refundable.
Northwest said it has relaxed the minimum stay requirements to give passengers more travel flexibility.
In a related announcement, Trans World Airlines Inc said it would match the Northwest discounts of up to 40 percent on 21-day advance-purchase fares for domestic flights.
TWA said the discounts would apply to routes competing with Northwest. TWA said travel requires a Saturday night stay and other restrictions apply.
UAL Corp, parent of United Airlines, told Reuters the carrier would also match the Northwest discounts in competing routes.
